:::{#thm-cross-entropy-decomposition}
#### Cross-entropy is entropy plus divergence

Let $p$ and $q$ be [probability mass functions](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pmf) on the values $x_1, \ldots, x_n$,
with $q(x) > 0$ wherever $p(x) > 0$.
Write $\entropyf{p}$ for the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) of $p$,
$\crossentropyf{p}{q}$ for the [cross-entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-cross-entropy) of $q$ relative to $p$,
and $\kldivf{p}{q}$ for the [Kullback--Leibler divergence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-kl-divergence) of $q$ from $p$,
all with base-2 [logarithms](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-logarithm).
Then

$$\crossentropyf{p}{q} = \entropyf{p} + \kldivf{p}{q}.$$

:::

::: {.proof}

Every [sum](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-sums.html#def-summation) here runs over the values $x$ with $p(x) > 0$.
For every such $x$,

$$
-\log_2 q(x)
= -\log_2 p(x) + \log_2 \frac{p(x)}{q(x)}.
$$

Multiply by $p(x)$ and add over $x$:

$$
-\sum_x p(x) \log_2 q(x)
= -\sum_x p(x) \log_2 p(x) + \sum_x p(x) \log_2 \frac{p(x)}{q(x)}.
$$

Reading left to right, these are $\crossentropyf{p}{q}$, $\entropyf{p}$ and $\kldivf{p}{q}$.

:::
